children: Alzamend Neuro, Inc. reported a net loss of $3.03M for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, compared with a net loss of $2.7M in the year‑ago quarter; diluted net loss per share was $(0.68). The company recorded no product revenue for the period.
Revenue was $0 for the quarter (no product revenue reported for both current and year‑ago quarters).
Net income: Net loss $3.03M for Q1 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), vs. net loss $2.70M in the year‑ago quarter (‑12% YoY).
Diluted EPS: Diluted net loss per share $(0.68) for the quarter, versus $(1.28) in the year‑ago quarter.
Clinical progress: Initiated and completed multiple Phase I/II imaging and Phase II trials for AL001 and ALZN002 with topline PK/PD data in 2026.
Product differentiation: AL001 demonstrated superior brain penetration, faster uptake and a distinct neurochemical profile versus lithium carbonate in healthy subjects.
Partnerships and technology: Collaborations with MGH/Harvard and Tesla Dynamic Coils supported five Phase II imaging trials and specialized head-coil development.
Operational shift: Clinical spend moved from Phase IIA imaging in 2025 to an ongoing Phase IIB BD study (scheduled to complete Sep 2026); ALZN002 restart was delayed to 2027.
